name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 9 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.79 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
